catalogueExport.wooCreateReferencesDescription: New categories, brands, attributes and terms can be created. Existing mapped references are reused; tax classes are not invented.
catalogueExport.wooDescription: Publish and synchronize your selected catalogue to this WooCommerce store. Stock uses the separate inventory synchronization workflow.
catalogueExport.languageDescription: Native WooCommerce stores one product language. Choose the Connect translation to publish.
catalogueExport.wooMappingDescription: Map existing WooCommerce identities and choose the fields Connect may publish. Unsupported Shopware-specific fields are not invented.
catalogueExport.wooAutomaticMapping: Existing connection mappings are reused. Prices must use the store currency; taxes require an equal-rate class. Woo metadata keeps its original keys without clearing unrelated fields.
catalogueExport.backlogDescription: {count} products awaiting inspection; oldest change: {seconds}s. Edits are combined and dispatched in small batches. An active connection run or shop outage can delay publication.
catalogueExport.automaticSyncDescription: Saving enables queued publication of matching new and changed products. Run Sync now for the initial catalogue. {provider} edits are protected; changing scope never deletes products.
catalogueExport.createReferencesDescription: Preview missing categories, manufacturers, properties, taxes, units, delivery times and compatible custom fields before creating them. Existing reference records are not silently overwritten. Languages and currencies must already exist.
catalogueExport.categoryRootDescription: Choose the {provider} navigation root to display new categories in its storefront tree. Without a parent, new categories remain independent roots.
catalogueExport.confirmSyncTitle: Sync the saved catalogue scope to {provider}?
catalogueExport.confirmSyncDescription: This creates missing products and updates matching products using the saved fields and publication status. Connect validates a fresh preview first and blocks the entire batch if validation fails. Existing stock is handled separately.
catalogueExport.title: Publish catalogue to {provider}
catalogueExport.description: Category, brand and manufacturer filters are combined with AND. Individual products are added separately. Exclusions apply to products, but required parents are still included. Nothing is deleted when filters change.
catalogueExport.emptySelectionNotice: No filters and no individual products means nothing is selected—not the entire catalogue.
catalogueExport.variants: Include variants of selected parent products
catalogueExport.mappingDescription: Standard fields are mapped automatically. Choose the field groups Connect may update and map destination references. These settings are separate from import matching.
catalogueExport.markupDescription: Applied to gross and net selling prices in the same currency. No currency conversion. Purchase costs are not exported.
catalogueExport.automaticMapping: Imported reference identities are reused. Languages and currencies match automatically by unique locale/ISO code; manual mappings override these matches. Multiple brands never replace the single manufacturer. Brand export, advanced price rules, downloads and recommendations are outside this first publication scope.
catalogueExport.historyDescription: Queued imports, export previews and publication results for this connection.
catalogueExport.stale: Selection or settings changed. Save and build a new preview before publishing.
catalogueExport.emptyDescription: Choose products and a destination channel, then build a preview. Missing mappings are reported here.
catalogueExport.confirmDescription: This writes the frozen preview to the connected shop. New products stay inactive unless activation was explicitly selected. Existing stock is never overwritten.

modes.keep: Keep existing status; new products inactive

planStatuses.failed: Publication failed — review History and Logs

common.tryAgain: Check the entered data and try again.

sales.title: Title
sales.orderOnlyCustomer: This customer was seen in an order; the full customer profile has not been imported yet.
sales.noSavedAddressesDescription: Addresses from past orders are kept with those orders. Import the customer's profile to see their current address book.
sales.noCustomerOrdersDescription: Orders linked to this customer will appear here.
sales.unmatchedProductsDescription: These product numbers are not linked to catalogue products: {skus}. This order cannot be allocated to a warehouse.
sales.noRecordsDescription: Orders and customers will appear here when you enable Sales import for a connected shop.
sales.noPickListsDescription: Orders with reserved warehouse stock appear here for picking.
sales.pickListNotice: This list shows currently reserved quantities. Picking does not ship or deduct stock; confirm shipments in Shopware until outbound fulfilment is connected.
sales.noPickLinesDescription: This order has no remaining warehouse reservation.
sales.pickTaskStartedDescription: Picked quantities can now be recorded against this reservation.
sales.pickTaskNoStockChange: No stock was deducted. Confirm the actual shipment in Shopware.
sales.pickTaskStale: Order changed after this pick list was created
sales.pickTaskStaleDescription: The reservation changed, possibly after a shipment or order edit. Recorded picks are preserved. A new task is allowed only when no goods were picked; otherwise resolve the physical goods first.
sales.shipmentReconciliationDescription: The connected shop has not provided exact shipped quantities. Enter the total units physically shipped so far for each product line; this records the warehouse deduction in Connect only.
sales.noPaymentsDescription: No payment transaction was imported for this order.
sales.noDeliveriesDescription: No delivery was imported for this order.

products.tabPreparation: This product area is the next implementation step.

categories.description: Organize categories by dragging them below another category.
categories.treeTipDescription: Drag a category onto another category to make it a child. Use the three-dot menu to add a category before, after, or inside it.
categories.noProductsSelectedDescription: Select products above to assign them to this category.
categories.customFieldsHint: Category custom fields from assigned sets will appear here.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.name: Integration name
integrations.salesImportDescription: Import customers and order snapshots from this connection.
integrations.salesImportFailed: Sales import could not be queued.
integrations.salesCustomersDescription: Import and update customer profiles and addresses.
integrations.salesOrdersDescription: Import orders with lines, taxes, payments, and deliveries.
integrations.salesContinuousSyncDescription: Process new connected-shop orders and status changes through the background sync worker. Historical orders never change stock.
integrations.salesSyncWaiting: Waiting for the first background sync.
integrations.connectManagesStockDescription: After reconciling initial warehouse quantities, publish Connect's available stock to the shop. Leave off during initial setup. WooCommerce requires independently managed, whole-unit product or variation stock.
integrations.importFailed: Product import could not be queued.
integrations.importScopeDescription: Choose the supported Shopware product data to include in each import.
integrations.wooImportScopeDescription: Import WooCommerce catalogue data into the shared catalogue. Core content uses your tenant's default language; multilingual plugins need separate adapters.
integrations.wooImportPipelineDescription: Imports use pages of 25. Historical Sales imports never change stock. Optional ongoing order sync runs through the background worker; stock publishing requires a separate reconciled cutover. Core WooCommerce shipment quantities must be confirmed in Connect. Protected downloads and extension-specific data need separate adapters.
integrations.areaProductsDescription: Core product information and identifiers are always imported.
integrations.areaTranslationsDescription: Names, descriptions, SEO content and translated custom fields.
integrations.areaBrandsDescription: Import all WooCommerce brands and product brand assignments. Manufacturer stays separate.
integrations.areaManufacturersDescription: Create and assign manufacturers or supported source brands.
integrations.areaTaxesDescription: Import source tax rates and supported product tax assignments.
integrations.areaUnitsDescription: Units of measurement and product reference quantities.
integrations.areaDeliveryTimesDescription: Delivery-time references used by imported products.
integrations.areaPricesDescription: Regular gross/net prices, list prices and currencies.
integrations.areaVariantsDescription: Import variants below their source parent product.
integrations.areaCustomFieldsDescription: Preserve sanitized custom fields and source metadata.
integrations.areaPropertiesDescription: Property groups, values and product property assignments.
integrations.areaCategoriesDescription: Category tree and product category assignments.
integrations.areaChannelPublicationsDescription: Product visibility in each imported sales channel.
integrations.areaCrossSellingsDescription: Shopware cross-selling groups and assigned products.
integrations.areaMediaDescription: Import product images and reconcile this connection's gallery assignments.
integrations.areaWooCrossSellingsDescription: WooCommerce cross-sells and up-sells, linked to the shared catalogue.
integrations.importPipelineDescription: Sales channels, currencies, units, tags, taxes, delivery times, manufacturers, properties, custom fields and categories are synchronized before products, variants and prices.
integrations.productMatchingDescription: Source IDs prevent duplicates. SKU and EAN are optional fallback matches for products created before the integration.
integrations.matchExternalIdDescription: Always used first through the stored source mapping.
integrations.matchSkuDescription: Match an existing product with the same SKU.
integrations.matchEanDescription: Match an existing product with the same EAN.
integrations.importHistoryDescription: The latest catalogue and Sales imports for this connection.
integrations.importLogDescription: Diagnostic entries for the selected import run. Credentials and source payloads are never logged.
integrations.noLogEntries: No log entries have been recorded for this import.
integrations.noImportHistory: No imports have been run yet.
integrations.cancelImportDescription: Already imported records will be kept. The worker will stop after its current item.
integrations.runQueuedDescription: Queued; no worker has started this job yet. The worker may be busy with another job. Keep the local worker running and check its terminal if the wait continues.
integrations.runNoRecentProgress: No progress reported for at least 2 minutes
integrations.runNoRecentProgressDescription: This does not prove the job is stuck. It may be waiting for Shopware or doing a slow operation. Check the worker terminal or cancel before trying again.
integrations.runProgressUnavailableDescription: The last known state is shown. Automatic retries continue; processing may still be running in the background.

inventory.adjustStockDescription: Set physical stock in the selected warehouse. The change is recorded in stock history.
inventory.stockDescription: Overview of physical and available stock for all products.
inventory.warehousesDescription: Manage warehouses used to calculate available stock.
inventory.fulfillmentDescription: Include this warehouse when stock is allocated for fulfilment.
inventory.warehouseDeactivationBlocked: Clear stock balances and reservations, resolve quarantined returns, and complete or cancel open purchase orders, transfers and stock counts before deactivating this warehouse.

inventoryTransfers.title: Transfers
inventoryTransfers.createValidation: Choose different warehouses and at least one product.
inventoryTransfers.cancelDescription: This draft transfer will be cancelled without changing stock.
inventoryTransfers.sendDescription: Sending removes these quantities from the source warehouse until they are received.
inventoryTransfers.receiveDescription: Receiving adds these quantities to the destination warehouse.
inventoryTransfers.emptyDescription: Create a transfer to move stock between warehouses.

suppliers.name: Supplier name
suppliers.emptyDescription: Add a supplier to prepare purchase orders.

inventoryCounts.title: Stock counts
inventoryCounts.createValidation: Choose a warehouse and at least one product.
inventoryCounts.postDescription: This adjusts stock to the counted quantities. Posting is rejected if stock changed after the count was created.
inventoryCounts.emptyDescription: Create a count to reconcile physical stock.

purchasing.quarantineDescription: Returned and scrapped goods leave physical stock. Released goods become saleable. This action is recorded and cannot be undone by editing the receipt.
purchasing.emailDescription: Send this PDF to {email}? This sends a real email.
purchasing.offerValidation: Choose a supplier and products, with valid costs, currencies, units and minimum quantities.
purchasing.offerTimingHelp: Validity dates say when this price can be used. Lead time is the number of days from ordering until delivery. Cost, minimum quantity and lead time are supplier-specific, not copied from the product.
purchasing.noOffersDescription: Add product costs and lead times from your suppliers before creating purchase orders.
purchasing.priceTierHelp: A price tier applies from its quantity during its valid dates. No price tier means this supplier-product link cannot be ordered yet.
purchasing.conversionHelp: Conversion states how much stock one purchase unit adds. For example, one case may add 12 stock units or one bottle may add 0.75 litres.
purchasing.noOrdersDescription: Create an order from active supplier offers.
purchasing.orderValidation: Choose a supplier, warehouse, and products that meet their minimum quantities and use one currency.
purchasing.sendDescription: This confirms the order and adds its open quantities to incoming stock. It does not send an email; use Email PO to supplier separately or deliver the PDF yourself.
purchasing.cancelDescription: Outstanding incoming quantities will be removed. Already received stock remains unchanged.
purchasing.receiptValidation: Enter a valid good or damaged quantity, no more than the outstanding amount.

supplierInvoices.title: Supplier invoices
supplierInvoices.emptyDescription: Record supplier invoices against received purchase orders, then match quantities, prices and totals.
supplierInvoices.noReceivedGoods: No received goods available to invoice
supplierInvoices.validation: Enter an invoice number, date and at least one valid line.
supplierInvoices.matchDescription: Compare invoiced quantities with good receipts, unit costs with the PO, and the stated total with calculated amounts. Any discrepancy will mark the invoice disputed; no payment is made.
supplierInvoices.voidDescription: Voiding removes this invoice from matched billed quantities but keeps an audit record. Enter the reason.

replenishment.title: Replenishment
replenishment.removeDescription: This removes the reorder rule, not any stock or existing purchase orders.
replenishment.validation: Choose a product and warehouse. Target must be higher than the non-negative reorder point.
replenishment.policyHelp: When available + incoming falls to the reorder point, suggest enough purchase units to reach target stock. Leave lead time empty to use the supplier offer.
replenishment.selectValid: Select suggestions that have a current preferred supplier offer.
replenishment.draftDescription: Create draft purchase orders for {count} selected suggestions? Orders are grouped by supplier, warehouse, and currency. Review them before marking sent.
replenishment.noSuggestionsDescription: Stock positions are above their reorder points, or no policies are configured.
replenishment.noPoliciesDescription: Add a product and warehouse policy to calculate purchase suggestions.

salesReturns.title: Returns
salesReturns.emptyDescription: Returned goods will appear here with their inspection and stock disposition.
salesReturns.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be positive and cannot exceed shipped goods not yet returned.
salesReturns.stockNotice: Only sellable restocks increase available stock. Quarantined goods stay unavailable.
salesReturns.authorityNotice: Record the physical return here. This does not change the Shopware order, refund a payment, or create a credit note.

operationsExceptions.title: Exceptions
operationsExceptions.retryDescription: The issue list has been refreshed. Queued stock updates are sent by the worker.
operationsExceptions.emptyDescription: New operational issues will appear here automatically.
